svg.title: Contact sheet: Low-Earth-orbit navigation
svg.desc: One tile per scenario kind of the family Low-Earth-orbit navigation, each the chart the engine writes for a bundled example of that kind, labelled with the kind and its ledger status: leo-signal MODELLED 2 · VALIDATED 2; leo-pass MODELLED 7 · VALIDATED 5; leo-navmsg MODELLED 5 · VALIDATED 6; leo-pvt MODELLED 3 · VALIDATED 2; leo-ppp MODELLED; ntn-positioning VALIDATED; leo-pnt-chain MODELLED. Modelled results from stated inputs, not measurements. Advisory: not type-approved navigation equipment.

svg.text: left: band-limited PSD of each design (dB below peak, across its transmit band); right: code jitter vs total C/N0 at 0.5 chip spacing
offset across ±0.6 × transmit bandwidth; 0 to −50 dB below each peak
code jitter (m, log scale) vs total C/N0 (dB-Hz)
